editorial:
If you want a DC animated movie that goes all in on danger, Justice League Dark: Apokolips War drops you into a world where the heroes already lost the first fight. Darkseid has wrecked Earth, and the survivors have to rebuild from the ground up. You follow Constantine, Raven, Superman, and a rough mix of Justice League, Teen Titans, and Suicide Squad members as they plan one last desperate attack. The tone is dark, fast, and emotional, with big battles and real stakes for characters you know.

The action is huge, the animation is sharp, and the story keeps moving, but it can feel crowded because so many characters share screen time. Some moments are brutal, so this is better for older teens and adults than younger kids. If you enjoy connected DC animated stories and high-stakes superhero finales, this is a strong pick.
endingExplained: In the final battle, the heroes defeat Darkseid, but Earth is left ruined and many heroes are gone. To fix the damage, Flash runs back through the Speed Force to reset the timeline before the war began. Constantine uses magic to shape that new beginning, giving the story a fresh start while keeping the emotional cost of everything that happened for everyone involved.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark superhero stories and connected DC animated movies.
